landing.title: Ship from China to New Zealand, door to door.
landing.intro: Sign in to get your instant quote.

steps.title: How it works
steps.one: Get an estimate for sea parcel, sea LCL and air, side by side.
steps.two: Send your goods to our Guangzhou warehouse with your member number on every carton.
steps.three: We weigh, measure and can combine your parcels. You confirm the final price before anything ships.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: Sign in to get your instant quote. We will email you a 6-digit code.

errors.send: We could not send the code. Please try again.
errors.code: That code is not right or has expired.
errors.codeFormat: Enter the 6 digits from the email.
errors.google: Google sign-in is not available right now.

inApp.title: Open this page in your browser
inApp.body: You are inside {app}. Sign-in works best in Safari or Chrome: tap ··· and choose “Open in browser”, or copy the link.

enroll.intro: Two-step verification is required. Scan this QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code.
enroll.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

quote.title: Get your instant quote
quote.intro: No shipping method is preselected: compare all three, then choose.

where.title: Where is it going?
where.cityHint: Choose the nearest city to your address.
where.postcodeNotFound: We could not find that postcode.
where.quoteOnRequest: Delivery to this area is priced on request. We will confirm the price with you.

cargo.title: Your cargo
cargo.intro: Enter each carton’s size and weight.

value.label: Total value of all items together
value.hint: Please enter the value in NZ$. If you paid in RMB, convert it at today’s exchange rate.

errors.submit: We could not get a quote right now. Please try again.

reasons.AIR_RULES_UNSIGNED: Air freight is quoted by our team for now. Message us for a price.
reasons.QUOTE_ON_REQUEST_ZONE: Delivery to this area is priced on request.
reasons.OVERSIZE: A carton is over 1.5 m on one side, so it needs a manual quote.
reasons.OVER_SEA_PARCEL_LIMIT: Sea parcel takes up to 100 kg and 1 m³. Choose Sea LCL instead.
reasons.FCL_RATE_EXPIRED: Our container rates are being updated. Message us for a price.
reasons.FCL_TRANSSHIPMENT_WELLINGTON: We do not quote Wellington from this port. Message us for options.
reasons.NAPIER_TAC_UNKNOWN: Napier port charges for these dates are being confirmed. Message us for a price.

productNotes.SEA_PARCEL: Small sea cargo, charged by kg. Up to 100 kg and 1 m³.
productNotes.SEA_LCL: Larger or bulky sea cargo, charged by volume. Delivered anywhere in NZ.
productNotes.AIR: Urgent cargo by air, charged by kg.

gst.title: GST (15%)
gst.local: NZ GST on our local fees: delivery and clearance fees carry 15% GST. International freight is GST-free.
gst.customs: Customs GST: for goods with a CIF value of NZ$1,000 or more, NZ Customs collects import GST and duty directly from you. This is not included in the estimate.

excluded.title: What is not included
excluded.intro: These may add to the cost if they apply:

quote.disclaimer: Estimate only. Delivery and clearance fees are plus 15% NZ GST. Your final price is confirmed at warehouse check-in, based on the actual weight and volume we measure in Guangzhou.

fcl.title: Full container (FCL)
fcl.intro: Estimate a 20 ft or 40 ft container from a China port to a New Zealand port.
fcl.addB: Add NZ local charges & door delivery →
fcl.partANote: Port to port: ocean freight, fuel adjustment (FAF) and emergency fuel (EFS). Excludes NZ local charges.
fcl.partBNote: In NZD, not converted. +GST on delivery and clearance.
fcl.summaryNote: The two currencies are shown separately and not converted.
fcl.validity: Estimate only · valid for 3 days, until {date}.
fcl.rateSheetExpired: Our container rate sheet expired on {date}. Estimates go to our team for a manual quote.

items.distance: Delivery within about 20 km of the NZ port city, by direct container truck. Longer distances cost more.
items.site: The delivery site must be approved to receive full containers.
items.tariff: Clearance covers up to 5 tariff lines. Each extra line is charged.
items.weight: Container weight up to 21 tonnes. Devanning is not included.

fcl.excluded: Not included: NZ import GST and duty, inspections, storage, demurrage and detention, waiting time, dangerous goods, overweight and other exceptional charges.
fcl.disclaimer: This estimate is for budgeting only. It is not an offer, booking or contract, and China Express is not liable for decisions based on it. Prices are confirmed only in a written quote.
fcl.whatsapp: Get a firm quote on WhatsApp
fcl.whatsappText: Hi China Express, please confirm an FCL quote: {size} from {origin} to {dest}. Estimate ref {ref}.

errors.required: Choose a size and both ports.
errors.submit: We could not get an estimate right now. Please try again.

new.title: Send a shipment notice
new.intro: Tell us your goods are on the way to our Guangzhou warehouse. This is a notice, not a payment.
new.expected: How many parcels are you expecting? (optional)
new.trackingHint: One per line. You can add them later.

prohibited.title: Goods we cannot ship
prohibited.intro: Do not send these to our warehouse:

items.dangerous: Dangerous goods: flammable, explosive or compressed items, and loose lithium batteries
items.biosecurity: Fresh food, plants, seeds, soil and animal products (NZ biosecurity)

prohibited.ack: I confirm my shipment contains none of the prohibited or restricted goods listed above.
prohibited.ackRequired: Please confirm before sending the notice.

done.title: We have received your shipment notice.

steps.one: Send your goods to our Guangzhou warehouse, with your member number on every carton.
steps.two: We check in and measure each parcel, and let you know.
steps.three: If you have several parcels, you can choose to combine them before the final price.
steps.four: You review and pay the final price. Then we ship and you can track it.

done.customs: If your goods are worth NZ$1,000 or more, NZ Customs needs a Customs Client Code before clearance. We will ask for it later.

address.title: Our Guangzhou warehouse
address.markRule: Suppliers must write your shipping mark on every carton. Unmarked parcels cannot be matched to you.
address.placeholder: The full warehouse address is being finalised. You can copy it here once it is ready.

tracking.title: Courier tracking number (optional)
tracking.intro: If your supplier has already shipped, add the domestic courier tracking numbers, one per line.
tracking.invalid: Each tracking number needs 4 to 50 characters.

label.title: Shipping mark
label.intro: Print this and stick it on each carton, or ask your supplier to write it clearly.

errors.submit: We could not send the notice. Please try again.
errors.load: We could not load this notice.

rates.title: Rates
rates.intro: Change rates in a draft, simulate the difference, then publish. Published versions cannot be edited and take effect on their effective date.
rates.selectVersion: Select a version to see its details.

detail.title: {product} · version {version}
detail.readOnly: Published versions are read-only. Create a draft from it to make changes.

editor.invalidNumber: Enter a number such as 2 or 69.50.

publish.title: Publish version {version}
publish.body: Once published it cannot be changed, and every channel quotes the new prices from {date}. Your name and the before and after values are recorded.

account.title: My account
account.markTitle: How to write your shipping mark
account.markBody: Ask your supplier to write this number clearly on every carton, exactly as shown. It is how our warehouse knows the parcel is yours.
account.methodsIntro: You can add another way to sign in while you are signed in. We never merge accounts automatically.
account.emailSent: Check {email} and confirm to finish adding it.
account.linkFailed: We could not link that sign-in method. If it already belongs to another account, sign in with it instead.
account.recoveryBody: Changed or lost your phone? Sign in with your email code, then update it here. If you cannot sign in any other way, contact us with your member number and a recent shipment, and our team will verify you.

demo.label: Demo
demo.body: Sample data: prices are fixed worked examples and do not change with your input. Any email, password and 6-digit code sign you in.
